meta.title: The XePrime mobile app
meta.description: Find a vehicle, send a booking request, message the owner and follow your trip — from your phone.

hero.title: XePrime in your pocket
hero.lead: The whole rental journey — search, ask, pick up, return — in one app. Owners manage their calendar and bookings from the very same place.

preview.heading: A first look
preview.note: Illustrative screens of a design still in progress, not the final build.

search.title: Find a vehicle
search.desc: Filter by service, location and time window; prices show right on the card.

trip.title: Your trip
trip.desc: Pick-up and return times, every line of the price, and the action buttons that match the trip status.

chat.title: Messaging
chat.desc: Talk to the shop directly and attach condition photos at handover.

notify.title: Alerts when they matter
notify.desc: The shop accepted your trip, the payment window is closing, pick-up time is near — straight to your phone.

chat.title: Messaging inside the trip
chat.desc: Ask before you book, send photos and documents at handover — all kept in the trip record.

handover.title: Handover with evidence
handover.desc: Photograph the vehicle, sign the handover record and save it to the trip — nothing to remember to send elsewhere.

host.title: Built for owners too
host.desc: Approve requests, block dates and check the money on each trip without opening a laptop.

download.heading: Be ready when it ships
download.body: The app is not on the App Store or Google Play yet. The two codes below currently open the XePrime homepage; when the app ships, these same codes will point straight to the stores.
download.qrAlt: QR code to download the XePrime app on {store}

web.heading: No app yet? Use the web
web.body: Everything the app does works on the website — nothing to install.
web.action: Find a vehicle on the web
